calendar.removeText: "{{title}}" will be removed from your calendar. The event stays in BirthReminder.
calendar.added: ✓ In your calendar · tap to remove

vote.keepDateText: Voting will close. All participants will be notified and will need to confirm again.
vote.keepPlaceText: Voting will close and participants will be notified.
vote.hintHost: Tap a date to keep it: voting will close and everyone will need to confirm again.
vote.hintGuest: Several choices allowed. Tap to tick or untick.

share.pool: Chip in to the money pool for "{{title}}" on BirthReminder: {{url}}

cancel.donePool: Your guests have been notified. The money pool is closed: no more contributions can come in. Amounts already paid are not refunded automatically.
cancel.doneText: Your guests have been notified by push and by email.
cancel.noReason: The host did not give a reason.
cancel.hint: The page stays available, but the event will not take place. If you added it to your calendar, remember to remove it.
cancel.sheetHint: All guests will be notified by push and by email. The event will stay visible, crossed out, with your reason. You can restore or delete it afterwards.
cancel.sheetPool: The money pool will be closed: no more contributions can come in. Amounts already paid are NOT refunded automatically. It is up to you to do it from the pool settings, and the Stripe fees of the original payments will remain at your expense.

uncancel.title: Restore this event?
uncancel.text: All guests will be told it is happening after all. The money pool stays closed: you can reopen it from the pool screen.

transfer.sentPool: {{name}} needs to accept. Note: the money pool will not follow. The {{amount}} € already paid will stay on your Stripe account, and it is up to you to refund or pass them on.
transfer.sentText: {{name}} needs to accept for the transfer to take effect. Until then, you remain the host.
transfer.acceptText: You will be in charge of invitations, votes and planning. The current host's money pool will be closed: amounts already paid stay on their account, and you can open your own afterwards.
transfer.bannerText: {{name}} is asking you to take over as host of "{{title}}".
transfer.bannerHint: You would be in charge of invitations, votes and planning. Any money pool does not follow: amounts already paid stay on the current host's account.
transfer.sheetHint: The person you choose will need to accept. Until they reply, you remain the host.
transfer.sheetPool: The money pool will not follow: amounts already paid stay on your Stripe account, and it is up to you to refund or pass them on.
transfer.nobody: Nobody has confirmed yet: there is no one to transfer to for now.

leave.title: Leave this event?
leave.text: You will no longer see its details or chat. The host can invite you again.

delete.title: Delete this event?
delete.text: Invitations, votes, gifts and messages will be permanently deleted.
